name: Scite
description: Scite delivers answers grounded in peer-reviewed research you can verify. Each response is backed by real scientific sources, with citations that show how studies have been supported, disputed, or contextualized by other researchers. Behind the scenes, Scite’s proprietary citation-based ranking model prioritizes trustworthy, validated research, helping users move beyond claims to evidence.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Scite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Scite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.scite.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Scite MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scite provides these MCP tools: search_literature.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Scite?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Scite in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.
Scite requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Scite is developed by Scite. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
